name: Healing Redtassel
description: Settle on bent knees with the blade lifted high as a hawk waits on the court's highest beam.

name: Berserk Guantang
description: Spring upward on the toes and cut up through the opponent's raised guard.

name: Unbowed Heavyblade
description: Sweep the blade tip out like a feather and tap an incoming spear off line.

name: Rumble Longsweep
description: Snare an enemy blade in the hook and tear it from its line with a quick pull of qi.

name: Thorn Guanhook
description: Open the arms wide with the pole across them to cover both flanks at once.

name: Might Rollcut
description: Cut upward on a rising lift of qi so the blade climbs through armor at the chin.

name: Ironsweep Wrath
description: Drive the tip and the butt spike in two quick strikes like the two talons of a stooping hawk.

name: Mayhemcrest
description: Circle the blade around the court in a held spinning cut that reaps all who enter the ring.

name: Gust Longsweep
description: Leap above the foe on a burst of qi and bring the blade down in a hawk's fall that splits stone and guard alike.

name: Crestinsight
description: Divide the stance into attacking and answering sides with the blade between them.

name: Lacerating Tailspike
description: Cut from the attacking side in a hard diagonal slash across the opponent's chest.

name: Unrelenting Counterspike
description: Answer the opponent's blow from the guarding side by turning it off the shaft.

name: Headlong Guanpole
description: Cross from one court to the other in a single long stride while the blade stays level.

name: Chime Slashdown
description: Hook an opponent's weapon from both sides in quick order and draw it out of their grip.

name: Hoarfrost Guantang
description: Turn the guard from one court to the other so a blow finds the shaft wherever it falls.

name: Loomhavoc
description: Slash once from the attacking court and again from the answering court with qi bridging both cuts.

name: Overlapping Bladecollar
description: Cut with the inner edge then the outer edge in one flowing exchange that leaves no gap for reply.

name: Ruinous Heavyswing
description: Wheel the blade through both courts to press every foe back toward the edge.

name: Intentloom
description: Deliver attack and answer together in one burst of qi so both courts rule on the opponent in a single blow.

name: Mightloom
description: Plant the feet as if testing the stones of a ford and set the blade across the body.

name: Loomscourge
description: Chop straight across the opponent's advance as a post cuts the current.

name: Charter Guanhook
description: Plant the pole upright and let blows break on it and flow on to either side.

name: Silt Bladewheel
description: Hop between footholds on the pole's planted tail as a crosser hops stones.

name: Beneficent Guanhook
description: Look past the opponent to the far side of the ground and choose where the crossing will land.

name: Berserk Tailspike
description: Turn in a tight eddy on the lead foot and slash across as the blade whips round.

name: Tuftdurance
description: Hook low behind the opponent's heel and drag it back like an undertow.

name: Murk Bladecollar
description: Hold a fixed line with the pole and turn every thrust aside as if a ford held against the flow.

name: Tuftwrath
description: Rush across the opponent's ground behind a rising sweep and drop of the blade like a flood.

name: Tufthavoc
description: Drive the blade down the centerline so the opponent's formation parts to either side.

name: Merciless Blaze Slashdown
description: Pour the whole qi field into one downward cut that bursts across the ground like a torrent in a ford.

name: Guanpole Vitality
description: Stand with the blade's inner and outer edges each set toward a separate side of the basin.

name: Sanguine Crescentback
description: Cut with the concave inner edge and drag the opponent's weapon toward the wielder.

name: Tempered Heavyblade
description: Cut with the convex outer edge and push the opponent's weapon away.

name: Ironguan
description: Cut with one edge and let the other follow on the same line so the second bite lands in the first wound.

name: Guanspine
description: Slope the blade along the opponent's strike so it slides down and out of the basin.

name: Gyve Heavyswing
description: Seat the opponent's shaft between the two edges and clamp it with a surge of qi.

name: Ruinous Slashdown
description: Sweep the blade along the rim of the fight so every foe standing there takes the edge.

name: Guanscourge
description: Bring both edges down in turn along a single drop so the opponent is cut twice by one stroke.

name: Nova Longsweep
description: Vanish from one edge of the basin in a burst of qi and reappear at the other with the cut already falling.

name: Might Polebelly
description: Sink the weight deep into the legs and hold the blade low like a stone sinking in still water.

name: Corroding Guantang
description: Open the exchange with a slow heavy downward cut that tests the opponent's guard.

name: Iron Counterspike
description: Hold the pole close and low to take blows on the deep part of the shaft.

name: Meteoric Longsweep
description: Skim across the ground in a light low step as a water bug crosses a pool.

name: Waningloom
description: Touch the blade tip to the opponent's weapon and feel through the shaft how deep their strength runs.

name: Gust Redtassel
description: Cut down with a pressing weight that drives the opponent's blade lower and lower.

name: Webbing Heavyswing
description: Drag the hooked blade backward along the ground to pull the opponent's footing out.

name: Torrent Counterspike
description: Meet a strike with a heavy slow turn of the pole that bears it down and away.

name: Gust Rollcut
description: Heave the blade up from the depths in a rising slash that takes the opponent off their feet.

name: Guanhavoc
description: Dive the blade down through the guard like a diver cutting the surface.

name: Redtassel Havoc
description: Circle the blade with steady pressure so the opponent feels the weight of qi bearing down on them.

name: Devastating Glint Guantang
description: Drop a pillar of pressed qi through the blade's point and edge and punch through guard and armor together.

name: Prescient Crescentback
description: Hold the blade ready in the stance of two hawks poised on a single bough.

name: Rumblecrest
description: Drop the first cut from above to draw the opponent's guard upward.

name: Wrathful Bladewheel
description: Follow with a rising cut from beneath into the space the first opened.

name: Gust Bladecollar
description: Move so that the wielder's shadow falls across the opponent's eyes while the blade follows.

name: Granite Ironsweep
description: Circle the opponent and slash from each side in turn as two hawks circle prey.

name: Tuftnerve
description: Pin the opponent's weapon to the ground with the hook as a talon pins small game.

name: Unbudging Crescentback
description: Cover the flank with the blade spread like a wing to turn a blow away from the ribs.

name: Lot Rollcut
description: Chase a retreating opponent with a stoop and a climb that alternate until the guard fails.

name: Titanic Polebelly
description: Spin low then high in a reaping pass that catches foes who scatter from the first stroke.

name: Hiltglimmer
description: Flash from above and below at once on a burst of qi so both hawks strike the opponent at one instant.

name: Might Guanhook
description: Set the hands apart on the pole and the feet wide so the blade's full length lies ready.

name: Mangling Longsweep
description: Cut from the far end of the pole to reach across the whole basin of the fight.

name: Nova Bladewheel
description: Jab the tip across a long gap at an opponent who thinks themselves safe.

name: Iron Heavyblade
description: Draw the blade in close behind the guard when the opponent crosses the long reach.

name: Unseen Ironsweep
description: Pace the rim of the fight at the blade's full reach so no opponent gets inside it.

name: Decimating Guanpole
description: Draw the blade through the longest arc the arms allow with qi stretched along its edge.

name: Rumble Polebelly
description: Hook an opponent's arm from the far end of the pole and haul them forward off balance.

name: Flintlike Tailspike
description: Hold the blade edge-on to an attack and let the keen edge turn it by its own cutting.

name: Titanic Guantang
description: Sweep low at the full reach to take the legs of an opponent who is stepping in.

name: Tempered Rollcut
description: Step across the whole gap in one lunge and bring the blade down at the end of it.

name: Thorn Tailspike
description: Press the full length of the blade down along an opponent's weapon and hold it pinned with qi.

name: Loomruin
description: Close from full reach to the body in three linked cuts that each shorten the grip.

name: Tempered Counterspike
description: Drive the entire length of the edge through the target in one stroke backed by the full qi field.

name: Vitalcrest
description: Stand square to the wind and plant the pole's tail as if swearing on the ground itself.

name: Sanguine Slashdown
description: Cut upward from the low ground the way the plateau lifts from the plain.

name: Loomspine
description: Hold the pole fixed before the body without moving even as the strike lands on it.

name: Toxin Rollcut
description: Hook the opponent toward the edge of the high ground and pull them off their stance.

name: Brutalizing Longsweep
description: Slash along the line already sworn so the blade neither wanders nor hesitates.

name: Chime Polebelly
description: Turn a strike aside with a sweep of the pole that follows the wind across the plateau.

name: Mayhem Bladewheel
description: Sweep the crescent out across the open ground in one oath-bound arc.

name: Blazeloom
description: Anchor the tail in the ground and cleave downward so the pole's whole weight rides on the cut.

name: Mightguan
description: Speak the oath aloud and bring the great crescent down with the whole qi field bound to the stroke.

name: Intent Guantang
description: Hold the blade loose and the body light as the wind passes around and through the stance.

name: Might Ironsweep
description: Cut with the long blade along the wind so the gale adds its push to the blow.

name: Facet Bladecollar
description: Hold the pole across the front and pledge not to yield the line while a blow falls.

name: Might Guanpole
description: Step along the chosen bearing and keep the blade pointed with the heading.

name: Clairvoyant Guanhook
description: Stop for a single breath and judge from the wind's shifts where the opponent will move.

name: Overpowering Ironsweep
description: Hook the opponent's guard in a quick gale-like pull that rips it open.

name: Hiltruin
description: Slash along the held bearing and let the wind's push at the back close the distance.

name: Equipoise Crescentback
description: Spin the pole into the wind and deflect an attack out toward the open side.

name: Dismantling Bladewheel
description: Wheel the blade in repeated sworn turns so the wind carries the reaping cut over a wide space.

name: Mastering Heavyblade
description: Wrap the pole around the opponent's weapon in a gale-like twist and lock it against their body.

name: Ferocious Iron Slashdown
description: Loose the whole qi field behind a single sworn cut that falls like the gale's own judgement.

name: Unerring Bladecollar
description: Stand square in the open wind with the blade low and the knees loose.

name: Crestscourge
description: Chop along the straight bearing from the shoulder to the target without any wasted motion.

name: Obdurate Polebelly
description: Angle the pole into a crosswind guard that turns blows away like blown seed.

name: Gust Slashdown
description: Keep the blade on the same heading through each pace so the line never breaks.

name: Gnashing Bladewheel
description: Slash through the gap that a gust opens in the opponent's guard.

name: Loommettle
description: Hook the opponent's weapon and let the wind drag it wide.

name: Chime Tailspike
description: Cross the pole over the held bearing to turn aside a blow from the side.

name: Hourguan
description: Link cut and thrust and sweep along the bearing so the gale itself seems to string them together.

name: Rumble Guanhook
description: Cut through a weapon and its wielder's guard in one gale-driven stroke.

name: Surging Rollcut
description: Flash along the held bearing on a burst of qi and land the cut where the opponent stood a moment before.

name: Radiant Tailspike
description: Stand with nothing at the back and the blade swinging free on every side.

name: Ironsweep Reckoning
description: Cut in the widest arc the open ground allows with the blade at full stretch.

name: Guannerve
description: Turn the pole to cover whichever flank an attack comes from.

name: Unseen Bladecollar
description: Take a long running step across open ground to bring the blade into reach.

name: Hiltinsight
description: Scan the horizon for any second attacker before committing the blade to the first.

name: Cresthavoc
description: Slash across with the edge turned to the open side where nothing blocks the arc.

name: Maiming Tailspike
description: Hook the opponent's shoulder and throw them with the push of a sudden wind.

name: Gust Crescentback
description: Spin the pole in a full turn that deflects any strike and resets the guard.

name: Punishing Heavyswing
description: Run after a retreating opponent and cut at their back before they reach cover.

name: Vengeful Guantang
description: Sweep the crescent around the whole open space so nothing within reach stands.

name: Polebelly Havoc
description: Spin the pole in a roaring gale of blows that pins opponents where they stand.

name: Hellish Longsweep Reckoning
description: Loose the entire qi field in one turning stroke that runs freely across the plateau in every direction.

name: Crestrespite
description: Speak the oath silently and stand with the blade pointed to windward.

name: Guanruin
description: Draw the great edge across the target in a long unhurried cut.

name: Facet Counterspike
description: Brace the pole against the wind and the blow together with both feet planted.

name: Might Bladewheel
description: Heave the great edge up through the opponent's guard with qi gathered in the legs.

name: Toxincrest
description: Haul an opponent's weapon toward the wielder with the hook and hold it there.

name: Torrent Guanpole
description: Parry from the windward side so the blow glides off with the wind's help.

name: Dismantling Heavyswing
description: Reap the open ground with the great edge in a single wide qi-driven pass.

name: Hollowcrest
description: Ride the wind into a long lunge that ends in a thrust and a cut at once.

name: Shattering Redtassel
description: Seal the oath into the blade and cut once with the full weight of the wind and the qi field.

name: Equipoise Redtassel
description: Stand with the edge turned to the opponent and the oath held in the steadiness of the breath.

name: Gusttuft
description: Slash with the edge at the full speed of a sudden gust.

name: Granite Heavyblade
description: Block with the pole planted square and give no ground to the blow that lands.

name: Torrential Longsweep
description: Take one unhurried step forward that commits the whole body to the exchange.

name: Booming Heavyswing
description: Draw the cleaving arc with a rising surge of qi so the edge bites through the guard.

name: Mayhemhilt
description: Hook the opponent's weapon and pull it past the wielder in a smooth pledged arc.

name: Gust Guanhook
description: Flick the pole against a strike so the oath's line is never crossed.

name: Blaze Rollcut
description: Sweep the blade low and wide to keep every foe beyond the sworn line.

name: Rumble Guanpole
description: Cut so fast the edge arrives before the sound of the wind that carries it.

name: Rumble Heavyblade
description: Pour the kept oath and the whole qi field into one final cut that ends the exchange.

name: Daybreak Counterspike
description: Stand braced on a ridge with the blade leaning into the thin wind.

name: Brutalizing Rollcut
description: Cut down from the higher ground so the slope itself adds to the blow.

name: Nova Guantang
description: Jab the tip fast through the thin air at the opponent's open throat.

name: Crestvalor
description: Lift the blade over the head and cover from any blow that falls from above.

name: Torrent Slashdown
description: Walk the narrow edge of a ridge with the pole held level to keep the balance.

name: Crescentback Scourge
description: Slash along the spine of the ridge so the cut follows the ground's line.

name: Toxin Bladecollar
description: Hook the opponent's guard in a shearing tug that rips it sideways like a gust on a ridge.

name: Adamantine Counterspike
description: Turn a blow aside with a quick spin of the pole as the wind pulls at the blade.

name: Tempered Polebelly
description: Cleave down with the high wind at the back and qi packed into the whole length of the edge.

name: Mayhem Heavyswing
description: Sweep the blade along the ridge in a roaring pass that sheers off any who stand on it.

name: Mangling Counterspike
description: Drive the tip forward on a thin hard line of qi that pierces guard and armor like a high wind through a gap.
